title: 菊花賞の後に・されど大団円

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huff! Wheeze!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: …I've still got a long ways to go.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Club Members
text_block_list.text: Fujiii! You were wonderful! Good job!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: That was fantastic! I didn't know what to expect after hearing about how she's more suited for mile races…

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: But she was astounding, win or lose! She tackled a huge challenge head-on without even flinching!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Her next race is going to be the Arima Kinen, right? Ooh, I can't wait to see it!
Although Fuji Kiseki has failed to claim victory, the audience is full of praise for her admirable efforts.
Passionate applause and cheers pour over her from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Dark-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Wow…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I didn't take first, but I was able to run my heart out thanks to all your support!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The curtain has closed on today's race, but I promise an even greater miracle awaits you at the next one!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Farewell until then!
Fuji Kiseki bows politely toward the stands, snaps her fingers, and…

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Where's the smoke coming from?! Where's Fuji Kiseki?!
With that, she makes her graceful exit.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Just wondering, but how do you feel about taking on the Takamatsunomiya Kinen next?
Shortly after we return from Kyoto, Fuji Kiseki stops by my office and opens a conversation with that sudden question.
I assumed she would want to run in the Japan Cup and the Arima Kinen, but I guess I was wrong.
Since the Takamatsunomiya Kinen is a sprint, I can't help but wonder…
choice_data_list: Are the long-distance races getting too difficult?
Are the long-distance races getting too difficult?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It's not that! I mean, it's true that I'm not great with long-distance races, but this has nothing to do with that.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: There are still some odds and ends I need to figure out, but I'll discuss everything with you once I'm ready, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: For now, can I please run the Takamatsunomiya Kinen? I'm sorry to spring this on you, but would it be okay?
I have so many questions… but I'm sure she has a plan, and I trust her.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I was thinking—I want to put on an even bigger show in my senior year than I did as a classic racer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You must've seen all the articles people have written about my trajectory on the Triple Crown tour, right?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Fuji Kiseki is bolstered by cheers of support as she takes on races against her aptitude."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Although her agenda has yet to be revealed, expectations are high."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Everyone is looking forward to her next show." Hehe! It's kind of embarrassing being lauded like this.
Come to think of it, almost every article out there is filled with profuse praise for her.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I was able to pull off a grand finale, and it went even better than I planned, to be honest!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm sure everyone's looking forward to an even bigger miracle from me, and I can't disappoint them!
The praise extolling Fuji Kiseki shows no signs of slowing.
If anything, her charismatic speech, miraculous exit from the venue, and theatrical announcement boosted her popularity exponentially.
Countless articles and video clips about her are uploaded every day.
